scene: The golden mic triggers a hidden stage platform sliding into an open transit hub.
picture: A flat side-view transit hub open to the cool night. On the far left, a light-rail pod sits open on tracks. The silver-haired boy in his mint hoodie and dance bag stands left of centre holding the mic. A flat moving walkway stretches in the centre. On the far right, a hover ferry rests at its dock.
shown: A sleek glass light-rail pod waiting open on an elevated track at the far left
A glowing moving walkway humming forward quietly on a bridge at the centre
A low blue river hover ferry idling at a passenger dock on the far right
